court: In the High Court of Madras
advocates: Mr. C. Srinivasan, for the Petitioner(s);
Mr. Leonard Arul Joseph Selvam Additional Public Prosecutor, for the Respondent(s).
judgment_text:
PRAYER : Criminal Original Petition is filed under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita Act, 2023 to direct the Respondent Police to file a final Report in Cr.No.964 of 2024 dated 19.11.2024 on the file of the respondent police and pass such further or other orders.

ORDER

1. The present Criminal Original Petition has been filed seeking a direction to the respondent Police to complete the investigation and file a final report in Crime No. 964 of 2024 before the jurisdictional Court.

2. When the matter was taken up for hearing today, the learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent Police submitted that the investigation in this case is under progress and the respondent Police will be able to complete the investigation and file the final report within a period of two months.

3. Recording the submission made by the learned Additional Public Prosecutor, this Court directs the respondent Police to complete the investigation and file the final report in Crime No. 964 of 2024 within a period of two months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

4. Accordingly, this Criminal Original Petition stands disposed of.
